v2_robustness.known_non_bit_reproducibility: SPY, QQQ, IWM, and TLT (all dividend-paying) do NOT hash-match the frozen v1 manifest; GLD (pays no distributions) matches byte-for-byte. This is disclosed as-is in the source report and its provenance file -- it is cited here, not restated as fixed or resolved. Re-running the acquisition script again may produce yet another distinct hash for the dividend-paying symbols; that is an expected, documented reproducibility risk, not a broken run.

regeneration_commands._note: Reproduced verbatim in substance from research/historical-market-regime-study.md Sec 8. These commands are NOT executed by this bundle and this bundle does not authorize their execution -- this bundle performs no re-run of any evaluation period.
regeneration_commands.primary_v1_requires: Frozen local raw CSVs under data/raw/yf_fd_etfs_daily_2015_2025_v1/ (gitignored); acquire via scripts/acquire_yf_fd_etfs_daily.py and verify the resulting dataset_canonical hash before use.
regeneration_commands.bootstrap_flag_note: --bootstrap-n-resamples 1000 matches the script's own default (n_bootstrap: int = 1000 in block_bootstrap_mean_ci/regime_bootstrap_uncertainty, src/financial_dynamics/backtesting/metrics.py) and what is actually recorded in every committed artifact's bootstrap_records[].n_bootstrap. Kept explicit here (rather than relying on the default silently) so the command remains self-documenting if the script's default ever changes. An earlier, superseded run used 150 resamples; those artifacts are preserved at results/historical_regimes/superseded_150_resamples/, not deleted, and are not used as evidence in this bundle except as an explicit before/after contrast in CASE-STUDY.md.

bootstrap_parameterization.requested_block_length_note: The value 20 counts REGIME OCCURRENCES, not trading days: block_bootstrap_mean_ci receives the filtered sequence of occurrence returns (src/financial_dynamics/backtesting/metrics.py). The experiment-config parameter this was read from retains the legacy 'trading days' wording for config-hash identity, so the unit is stated here and in SOURCE-GATE.md's 'Bootstrap / uncertainty detail' section instead of being renamed at the source.
bootstrap_parameterization.sparse_cell_rule: effective_block = max(1, min(block_size, n)); reported back verbatim in each bootstrap record's own block_size field. See SOURCE-GATE.md's 'Bootstrap / uncertainty detail' section and tables/bootstrap_sparse_cells_full.md for all 174 verified rows where n < 20.
